note: Sources: her quantization lecture is the recording transcribed in course/L13.transcript.md (it opens "for this lecture, we will cover large language model quantizations"); course/L12.transcript.md is the serving lecture, and the slide markers in both transcripts point at the other PDF. Slides: course/L12.txt / L12.pdf.
beats: Hook: rounding has no slope, so gradients die on it; the fix is a polite lie: pretend the slope is 1 (line_ste_flat_step, then line_ste_handrail).

PTQ vs QAT (slide 36): post-training quantization trims the finished model to fit; quantization-aware training learns with the rounding in the loop from the start, like baking in the small tin (line_qat_cake_two_ways).

The gradient problem (slide 37): learning feels its way downhill; on a staircase every tread is flat (gradient 0) and every edge is a cliff (infinite) (line_ste_flat_step, line_ste_marble_plank left; line_switch_dimmer).

Straight-through estimator: walk on the steps (the forward pass uses the rounded value) but feel the handrail (the backward pass assumes slope 1) (line_ste_handrail, line_ste_marble_plank right). Clipped STE: the rail ends where the stairs end, so outside the range the gradient stops.
LoRA (slide 38): freeze the big W, train two thin matrices B and A whose product is the update (line_lora_glass_case).
QLoRA (slides 38-39): store the frozen base in 4 bits and keep the small adapters in 16 bits: a big model fine-tuned on one GPU (line_qlora_pocket_edition).

NF4 (slide 39): weights are bell-shaped, so put the 16 levels where the weights are: umbrellas packed in the crowded middle of the beach, sparse at the ends (line_nf4_beach_umbrellas; vs INT4's even hooks, line_bits_hook_rails from L12-01's plan).
The tour in one picture (slide 40): data types, rounding basics, the benefit check, GPTQ / AWQ / SmoothQuant, NVFP4, PTQ and QAT (line_quant_tour_shelf); callback to L10-02: FP8 rollouts in RL.
Takeaway: you can train through rounding if you are honest about where you lie (only in the backward pass, only inside the range).
Cover (line_cover_l12_05; for the X post and thumbnails, not a film beat): the blindfolded student walks down a staircase of flat steps, guided by one smooth sloping handrail.
